examples.explanation: Whitespace is normalized before title casing.

problem.explanation: Split the input into words, join them with one space, then title-case the result.
hints: Split without an argument to collapse whitespace.
Join the words before applying title casing.
problem.statement_markdown: Implement `normalize_name(value)` so surrounding whitespace is removed, internal whitespace runs become one space, and each word is title-cased.
problem.title: Normalize a display name
